_doc: Story arcs (GAME_DESIGN.md §6, CHARACTERS.md). A beat: id, char (the key character), window (year = your level 1–6 or [from,to], term, week, dow 0=Mon…6=Sun, blocks = block kinds/ids when it can start), when = conditions (rel:char>=50, trust:k_id>=N, ledger:snitched_on:char, arc:char=state, done:beatId, present:k_id, pos:3 = top-3 last report, religion:, gender:, money:N, or any game condition). how: call (they come and find you; ignoring has consequences) | scene (plays right away). small: allowed on a day that already had a beat. choices[].fx: rel/trust/rivalry/respect/crush (number = the beat's character, or {id: n}), stats, money, clout, favour, rep{group}, items, take, knowledge{code|any: n}, path, note[] (ledger), arc (state), end (best|mid|low — their "where are they now"), leave (they leave school: reason), flag, discipline (minor offence text), offence{what,sev}, game (whot|race), milestone. Text: {name} {nick} {full} {me} {when:ledgerKey} {who:k_id}.

beats.title: {name} Can't Sleep
beats.text:
It's past lights out. From the top bunk you hear sniffing. {name} is crying quietly into the pillow.

"I want to go home… I miss my mum."

choices.label: 🤝 Climb up and talk until they fall asleep
choices.reply: You whisper jokes about the house master's torchlight until {name} laughs. "My person," they mumble, and finally sleep.

choices.label: 🍪 Pass up your biscuits
choices.reply: A hand reaches down and takes the biscuits. "Thank you," very small. The crying stops.

choices.label: 😴 Pretend you're asleep
choices.reply: The sniffing goes on for a long time. In the morning {name} doesn't look at you.

beats.title: Last Card Under the Bunk
beats.text: {name} waves a battered pack of shape cards: "Make we start our own tournament. Loser washes the winner's plate for one week."

choices.label: 🃏 "Deal me in!"
choices.reply: It becomes your thing — every siesta, under the bunk.

choices.label: 📚 "After prep, I wan read"
choices.reply: {name} shrugs. "Book worm."

beats.title: {name} and Zara
beats.text: {name} has been sitting with Zara at every meal. Zara's provisions are endless. Today they walk past you without waving.

choices.label: 🫂 Ask {name} to come back to your table
choices.reply: "Sorry, my person… her chin-chin just sweet pass." They laugh. You're fine.

choices.label: 🤝 Invite Zara to sit with both of you
choices.reply: Zara looks surprised to be invited somewhere without her provisions. The three of you laugh till the prefect shouts.

choices.label: 😤 Sulk
choices.reply: You eat alone. {name} notices. Nobody says anything.

beats.title: Something's Wrong With {name}
beats.text: {name} hasn't eaten properly in two days. Their test scores are falling and they jump when anybody calls their name. Today they're sitting alone behind the hostel.

choices.label: 🫂 Sit with them and ask, gently
choices.reply: Long silence. Then: "My parents are separating. Nobody at home is talking." You sit there until the bell. "Thank you for asking," they say.

choices.label: 📚 Help with their notes instead
choices.reply: You copy notes together. {name} is grateful, but whatever it is stays unsaid.

choices.label: 🙈 Give them space
choices.reply: You leave them alone. Later you hear from others what was wrong. You wish you'd asked.

ignore.text: {name} waited behind the hostel. You never came.

beats.title: "Is It True?"
beats.text: Bisola corners you by the tap, notebook ready: "Is it true {name}'s parents are divorcing? I heard it from somebody."

choices.label: 🤐 "Mind your own business, Bisola"
choices.reply: Bisola sniffs and walks off. {name} never finds out how close the secret came.

choices.label: 🗣️ Tell her
choices.reply: By dinner the whole class knows. {name} looks at you across the dining hall like a stranger.

beats.title: "I Like Tams Too"
beats.text: {name} finally says it: "I like Tams. I know you do too. I no want make this thing scatter us."

choices.label: 🤝 "Friendship first. Always."
choices.reply: {name} hugs you. "My person." Whatever happens with Tams, this stays.

choices.label: 😤 "Then may the best person win"
choices.reply: You both stop sitting together. The dormitory feels bigger.

beats.title: Make Up?
beats.text: It's been weeks. {name} is alone at the tap with two buckets.

choices.label: 🙏 Carry one bucket and apologise
choices.reply: "I missed you, you this stubborn somebody." You walk back together, splashing water everywhere.

choices.label: 🚶 Walk past
choices.reply: Pride is heavy. So is a bucket.

beats.title: First Signature
beats.text: Sign-out week. {name} holds out a marker before anyone else can: "You first. You were always first."

choices.label: ✍️ Sign their shirt — and hand them yours
choices.reply: "My person — JSS1 to SS3." They write the same on yours. Neither of you can talk for a minute.

choices.label: 😅 Make a joke of it
choices.reply: You both laugh. Some things are too big to say.

beats.title: "Second Position?"
beats.text: {name} finds you with the report cards: "You came top three. Interesting." They adjust their glasses. "Next term I will not leave anything for you."

choices.label: 🤝 "Make we read together instead"
choices.reply: {name} hesitates, then nods. "Library. 4 PM. Don't be late."

choices.label: 😏 "Catch me if you can"
choices.reply: "Point of correction: I won't need to catch you. I'm ahead." Game on.

choices.label: 🙇 "You deserve first"
choices.reply: {name} looks almost disappointed. "Don't give up so easily."

beats.title: "Some People Came to Play"
beats.text: {name} glances at your report card: "Hmm. Some people came to play, I see."

choices.label: 🔥 "Watch me next term"
choices.reply: "I'll be watching," {name} says. They sound like they mean it.

choices.label: 📚 "Teach me your way"
choices.reply: {name} blinks, then pulls out a timetable written in three colours.

beats.title: The Quiz Team
beats.text: Mrs. Johnson picks you and {name} for the inter-school quiz. {name}: "We need to practise. Every day. I've made a schedule."

choices.label: 📚 Practise together every day
choices.reply: Two weeks of drills. You win the semi-final — {name} high-fives you, then pretends it didn't happen.

choices.label: 🏅 Fight for the team captaincy
choices.reply: You argue about who answers buzzers. You lose in the final — but the rivalry is legendary.

beats.title: The Expo
beats.text: {name} pulls you behind the library, shaking: "Osas has BECE expo. Maths and English. I can't come second. My father will…" They can't finish.

choices.label: 🛑 Talk them out of it
choices.reply: You talk until the prep bell. {name} tears the paper in half. "If I fail, I fail honestly. Thank you."

choices.label: 🤫 Look away
choices.reply: You say nothing. {name} walks away with the paper, and with something heavier.

choices.label: 📣 Tell the VP
choices.reply: The VP raids the hostel. {name} is questioned for hours. They know it was you.

choices.label: 🙋 "Share it with me"
choices.reply: The expo turns out to be fake. Worse — the VP found the paper in your locker.

beats.title: {name} in the Toilet
beats.text: You hear counting from the end cubicle. "…forty-one, forty-two…" It's {name}, breathing too fast, counting tiles before the exam.

choices.label: 🫁 Stay and breathe with them
choices.reply: In. Out. Slowly the counting stops. "Please… don't tell anybody." You never do.

choices.label: 🩺 Fetch Nurse Grace
choices.reply: Nurse Grace knows exactly what to do. {name} is embarrassed — and grateful.

choices.label: 🗣️ Tell the others later
choices.reply: "The brilliant one dey fear exam!" {name} hears it everywhere. They never forgive you.

beats.title: Mock Interview
beats.text: {name} has a scholarship interview for a school abroad: "Interview me. Be hard. Be the worst interviewer you can imagine."

choices.label: 🎤 Grill them properly
choices.reply: You ask the hardest questions you can think of. A month later: "I got it. You were harder than the real panel."

choices.label: 😅 Go easy
choices.reply: You go easy. {name} rolls their eyes but thanks you anyway.

beats.title: "Your Bucket. Your Strongman."
beats.text: {nick} blocks the corridor, arms folded: "New student. Your bucket, your Strongman. Now."

choices.label: ✊ "No. Go and fetch your own."
choices.reply: {nick} stares at you for a long time. Then laughs. "You get mind." They walk off. People saw.

choices.label: 📣 Report to the house master
choices.reply: {nick} gets punished. Later, passing your bunk: "Snitch. I go remember."

choices.label: 🥛 Hand it over
choices.reply: {nick} takes it with a smirk. It won't be the last time.

ignore.text: You avoided {nick} — so they helped themselves to your Strongman.

beats.title: {nick} and the Letter
beats.text: You find {nick} alone by the tap, frowning at a punishment letter, lips moving slowly. You realise the paper is upside down.

choices.label: 📖 Quietly offer to read it with them
choices.reply: {nick} goes rigid. Then, very quietly: "Nobody must know." You read it together, slowly, one word at a time.

choices.label: 😂 Laugh
choices.reply: {nick} crumples the letter. "Laugh. Go on. I go show you something."

choices.label: 🚶 Pretend you saw nothing
choices.reply: You walk on. Some secrets are not yours.

beats.title: Secret Lessons
beats.text: {nick} finds you after prep: "Those lessons… make we continue. Every night. Nobody must know."

choices.label: 📚 Teach them every night
choices.reply: Weeks of whispered reading under a torchlight. One night {nick} reads a whole page alone and nearly cries.

choices.label: 😓 "I no get time"
choices.reply: "Okay." Just that. {nick} doesn't ask again.

beats.title: {nick} Remembers
beats.text: {nick} blocks your path: "You remember {when:snitched_on}? You sold me out. Today I go collect."

choices.label: 🙏 Apologise — properly
choices.reply: {nick} wasn't expecting that. "…Okay. We dey even."

choices.label: ✊ Stand your ground
choices.reply: It turns into a scuffle before Senior Chuka pulls you apart. Nobody wins. Everybody saw you didn't run.

choices.label: 📣 Call your school parent
choices.reply: Senior Chuka appears. {nick} backs off — for now.

beats.title: {nick} vs Commander
beats.text: Commander slaps a small JSS1 boy for "looking at him". {nick} steps between them: "Senior, e don do." The whole corridor goes silent.

choices.label: 🧍 Stand beside {nick}
choices.reply: Two of you. Commander looks from {nick} to you… and walks off cursing. The JSS1 boy will never forget it.

choices.label: 🤐 Stay out of it
choices.reply: {nick} takes two strokes of the belt alone. They don't look at you after.

beats.title: {nick}'s BECE
beats.text: BECE results are pinned on the noticeboard.

choices.label: 📋 Look for {nick}'s name
choices.reply: {nick} passed — every subject. They find you in the crowd and lift you off the ground. "YOU! Na you do this!"

choices.label: 📋 Look for {nick}'s name

fx.leave: is repeating JSS3 and drops out of your set

choices.reply: {nick} didn't make it. They're repeating JSS3. They pack their box without a word.

beats.title: Labour Prefect
beats.text: The prefect list goes up. Under Labour Prefect: {full}. {nick} finds you: "Me. A prefect. Who for think am?"

choices.label: 😄 "I always knew"
choices.reply: {nick} spends SS3 protecting juniors from the kind of senior they used to be.

beats.title: "WHO DID THIS?"
beats.text:
{name} draws a perfect Mr. Bassey on the blackboard — cane, belly and all. The class is crying with laughter. Then Mr. Bassey walks in.

"WHO. DID. THIS?"

choices.label: 🙋 Take the blame with {name}
choices.reply: You both kneel at the back for the whole period. {name} whispers impressions the entire time. Worth it.

choices.label: 👉 Point at {name}
choices.reply: {name} gets three strokes. The class looks at you differently.

choices.label: 🤐 Stay silent with everyone
choices.reply: "Then EVERYBODY frog jump!" The whole class suffers together. Somehow, it bonds you.

beats.title: Cultural Day Skit
beats.text: {name} has written a skit for Cultural Day: "The Principal's Generator". "I need you for the main role. You get the face."

choices.label: 🎭 Take the role
choices.reply: The skit brings the house down. Even the principal laughs — once.

choices.label: 🙅 "Stage fright, sorry"
choices.reply: {name} finds someone else. You laugh from the audience.

beats.title: {name} Goes Home
beats.text: The house master calls {name} out of class. By evening, everybody knows: his father has passed. He's going home for the burial.

choices.label: ✍️ Write him a letter
choices.reply: Weeks later he comes back with your letter folded in his pocket. "You wrote three pages. I read am every night."

choices.label: 💰 Collect a class contribution
choices.reply: The class raises ₦8,400. He tries to joke about it and can't.

choices.label: 🤷 Leave it to the teachers
choices.reply: He comes back quieter. Something has changed.

beats.title: Make Him Laugh Again
beats.text: {name} hasn't made a single joke all term. The class is too quiet.

choices.label: 🎭 Do your worst Mr. Bassey impression for him
choices.reply: It's terrible. {name} laughs so hard he cries — and then he's back. "Your impression no reach mine at all."

choices.label: 🤐 Give him time
choices.reply: Time helps, slowly.

beats.title: Co-host the Send-forth?
beats.text: {name} is MC for the send-forth party: "Co-host with me. You and me. One last show."

choices.label: 🎤 "Let's go!"
choices.reply: You two run the whole night. The juniors will talk about it for years.

choices.label: 🙈 "I go dey watch"
choices.reply: You watch him own the stage.

beats.title: The Rough Sheet
beats.text: Mr. Bassey is still writing the problem on the board. {name} has already solved it on her rough sheet — two lines, perfect. Nobody notices except you.

choices.label: 🧮 Ask her to explain it after class
choices.reply: She explains it in four words and one diagram. Suddenly it's obvious.

choices.label: 📣 "Sir! Halima don solve am!"
choices.reply: Every head turns. {name} looks at her desk like she wants to disappear.

choices.label: 👀 Keep the secret
choices.reply: She notices you noticed. A tiny nod.

beats.title: The Olympiad Form
beats.text: There's a state Mathematics Olympiad form on the noticeboard. {name} has stood in front of it three days in a row, but she hasn't signed it.

choices.label: ✍️ "We sign together. I'll be your team."
choices.reply: She signs. You come second-to-last; she comes FIRST in the state.

choices.label: 🤷 "Maybe next year"
choices.reply: The form comes down on Friday.

beats.title: The Letter From Home
beats.text: {name} shows you a letter, hands shaking. Her uncle wants her withdrawn after JSS3. "He says girls don't need more school. My mother is fighting, but…"

choices.label: 🏛️ Go with her to the principal
choices.reply: Dr. Bamidele reads the letter and picks up the phone. A scholarship. A meeting with her uncle. She stays.

choices.label: ✍️ Get Miss Ekwueme and the teachers to write
choices.reply: Twelve teachers sign. Her uncle backs down. "I've never seen my name in so many people's handwriting," she says.

choices.label: 🤲 "I'm so sorry…"
choices.reply: She folds the letter away. "It's okay. It's not your fight."

ignore.text: {name} waited for you by the library. Nobody else knew.

beats.title: Goodbye, {name}
beats.text: Her uncle's car is at the gate. {name} hugs you once, quickly, and presses a folded paper into your hand: a perfect geometry proof, signed "for my friend".

choices.label: 💌 Keep it forever
choices.reply: You keep the proof in your Bible/Qur'an for six years.

beats.title: Nationals
beats.text: {name} made the national team. "They said I can bring one friend as my 'team'. Will you come?"

choices.label: 🎒 Of course
choices.reply: Abuja. A hotel with a swimming pool. {name} wins gold and dedicates it "to my school and my friend".

beats.title: Business Proposal
beats.text:
{nick} holds up a blue bucket: "Brand new. ₦500. Special price for you."

It's YOUR bucket. Your name is written on it in marker.

choices.label: 😂 Laugh — "My guy, partner with me instead"
choices.reply: "Ah! You get business sense!" A partnership is born.

choices.label: 📣 Report him
choices.reply: He gets punished. He also never sells you anything ever again.

choices.label: 💰 Buy it back for ₦100
choices.reply: "Customer is king!" He even polishes it.

beats.title: The Provision Business
beats.text: {nick}: "Mama Bisi raised her prices. We sell Jolly Roll and pure water in the hostel at night. Put in ₦300, you double am by Friday."

choices.label: 🤝 Invest ₦300
choices.reply: By Friday you have ₦600. {nick} even shows you the books. Honest hustle.

choices.label: 🙅 "Too risky"
choices.reply: He shrugs. "Your loss."

beats.title: Where the Money Goes
beats.text: You catch {nick} at the school phone, voice soft: "Mummy, I don send am. Buy the drugs first." He sees you.

choices.label: 🤐 "I didn't hear anything"
choices.reply: "…Thank you. Make e stay that way." He tells you the whole story later anyway.

choices.label: 🗣️ Tease him about it
choices.reply: His face closes like a door.

beats.title: The Expo Business
beats.text: {nick} has WAEC mock "expo" and a list of buyers. "Twenty people don pay. I need one partner wey I fit trust. ₦2,000 your share."

choices.label: 🛑 Talk him out of it
choices.reply: It takes all night. He burns the papers. "If my mother hear, she go die. You don save me."

choices.label: 💸 Join him
choices.reply: Easy money. Too easy.

choices.label: 📣 Report him to the VP

fx.leave: was expelled for selling exam expo

choices.reply: The VP storms the hostel. {nick} is expelled by Monday. He never looks back at you.

choices.label: 🤷 Stay out of it
choices.reply: You say nothing. That's a choice too.

beats.title: Caught
beats.text: The VP's raid finds {nick}'s expo list. Your name is on it.

choices.label: 😰 Face the VP

fx.leave: was expelled for selling exam expo

choices.reply: {nick} is expelled. You're on final warning.

choices.label: 😮 Watch it happen

fx.leave: was expelled for selling exam expo

choices.reply: {nick} is expelled. He packs his box alone.

beats.title: The First Receipt
beats.text: A letter from Benin, in {nick}'s mother's careful handwriting, and a receipt: "Igbinedion Provisions — Customer No. 1". It's made out to you.

choices.label: 🧾 Keep it in your box
choices.reply: {nick}: "She say make I thank the friend wey stop me."

beats.title: Your Name in the Notebook
beats.text: {nick} writes your name in her little notebook: "Talking after lights out." She doesn't even look up.

choices.label: 🍛 Invite her to sit with you at dinner
choices.reply: She stares. "…Why?" But she comes. She doesn't write your name again.

choices.label: 😠 Confront her
choices.reply: "Rules are rules," she says, voice shaking.

choices.label: 🙏 Beg her
choices.reply: She sighs and crosses it out. Just this once.

beats.title: The Missing Notebook
beats.text: You find {nick}'s notebook in the bin behind the hostel. Emeka grins: "Read am! The whole class gist dey inside!"

choices.label: 📓 Return it to her — unread
choices.reply: She clutches it. "You didn't read it?" "No." She believes you. Nobody has ever done that.

choices.label: 👀 Read it first
choices.reply: Pages of names… and, at the back: "Things I would say if anybody asked me." You put it back, feeling strange.

choices.label: 📢 Read it out to the class
choices.reply: The class roars. {nick} runs out. You were funny for one evening.

beats.title: {nick} Alone
beats.text: {nick} eats alone every day now. Someone poured water on her bed. She's pretending not to care.

choices.label: 🏴 Invite her into your squad / group
choices.reply: She doesn't smile at first. By Friday she's organising your study timetable.

choices.label: 🤷 Not your business
choices.reply: It isn't. Or is it?

beats.title: "Will You Endorse Me?"
beats.text: Prefect selection is coming. {nick}: "The principal asks seniors for endorsements. Will you… endorse me for Head Girl?"

choices.label: ✍️ Endorse her
choices.reply: She becomes the fairest Head Girl the school has had in years.

choices.label: ✍️ Endorse her for Head Prefect
choices.reply: She becomes the fairest Head Prefect the school has had in years.

choices.label: 🤔 Endorse someone else
choices.reply: She understands. Mostly.

beats.title: Three Chop Boxes
beats.text: {name}'s driver carries in her third chop box. She glances at yours: "Is that all you brought? Cute."

choices.label: 😂 Laugh it off
choices.reply: "Okay, you're funny," she admits.

choices.label: 🔥 "At least I carried mine myself"
choices.reply: The corridor goes "OHHH". {name} looks… impressed?

choices.label: 🍪 Ask what's inside hers
choices.reply: Crunchos. Imported cocoa. She gives you one Cruncho. Generous, by her standards.

beats.title: Nobody Came
beats.text:
Visiting Day. Cars everywhere, coolers of jollof, mothers crying. You find {name} hiding in the toilets, eyes red.

"Nobody came. Again."

choices.label: 🍛 Bring her to share your family's food
choices.reply: She eats your mum's jollof like it's the best food in the world. Your mum adopts her on the spot.

choices.label: 🫂 Sit with her for a while
choices.reply: You don't say much. She doesn't need you to.

choices.label: 🚶 Leave her be
choices.reply: You hear her come out much later, face washed, chin up.

beats.title: The Newspaper
beats.text: Somebody smuggled in a newspaper. Front page: {name}'s father, a corruption scandal. The whole school is talking. {name} sits very straight at dinner, alone.

choices.label: 🛡️ Sit with her, loudly
choices.reply: "Anybody get something to say?" Nobody does. She squeezes your hand under the table.

choices.label: 🗞️ Join the gossip
choices.reply: It's juicy gist. You don't think about her face.

beats.title: Transferred
beats.text: {name}'s mother arrives from London. Two days later, {name} is gone.

choices.label: 👋 Watch the car go

fx.leave: was transferred to a school in London

choices.reply: She doesn't look back. Or maybe she does, and you missed it.

beats.title: The After-Party
beats.text: {name}: "Send-forth after-party. My aunty's house in town. You're my guest of honour. No arguments."

choices.label: 🎉 Go
choices.reply: Best night of SS3. She gives a speech about "the person who shared jollof with me in JSS1".

beats.title: The Tuck Shop Queue
beats.text: {name} stands near the tuck shop every break, watching. He never joins the queue.

choices.label: 🍪 Buy two Jolly Roll and "accidentally" have one extra
choices.reply: "You buy two? Okay… I go help you finish am." He grins. No pity, just Jolly Roll.

choices.label: ❓ Ask why he never buys anything
choices.reply: "I no dey hungry," he says. He is.

choices.label: 🚶 Join the queue
choices.reply: He's still there when you come back.

beats.title: Sent Home for Fees
beats.text: At assembly the bursar reads a list: students owing fees must go home TODAY. "…{full}." {name} walks to the gate carrying his box, chin up.

choices.label: 💰 Organise a class contribution
choices.reply: The class raises the balance by evening. {name} comes back from the gate. He can't speak. He just nods at you, again and again.

choices.label: 🏛️ Go to the principal about a scholarship
choices.reply: Dr. Bamidele checks his grades. "This boy is first in Chemistry?" A scholarship, on one condition: stay in the top five.

choices.label: ✍️ Promise to write to him
choices.reply: You write every week. He writes back from Aba market.

choices.label: 😔 Watch him go

fx.leave: was sent home for fees and never came back

choices.reply: The bus leaves. His bunk stays empty for the rest of the year.

beats.title: The Scholarship Exam
beats.text: {name} has to stay in the top five to keep his scholarship. "Chemistry is fine. Maths is killing me."

choices.label: 📚 Study together every night
choices.reply: You both finish top five. He buys you a Jolly Roll with his own money. First time.

choices.label: 😅 "You go manage"
choices.reply: He manages. Barely.

beats.title: WAEC Results
beats.text: {name}'s WAEC results come in: nine A1s. He walks straight past the crowd to find you.

choices.label: 🤗 Hug him
choices.reply: "If not for you, I for still dey Aba market," he says. You both know it's not entirely true. You let him say it.

beats.title: The Relay Team
beats.text: {nick} at inter-house practice: "We need a fourth leg for the relay. You fit run small?"

choices.label: 🏃🏾 "Put me in!"
choices.reply: You train with him every Wednesday. Your house wins the relay.

choices.label: 🙅 "I go cheer"
choices.reply: He finds another runner. You cheer the loudest.

beats.title: Torn Boots
beats.text: {nick}'s football boots split in two during practice. He tapes them with nylon and pretends it's fine.

choices.label: 💸 Buy him boots (₦1,500)
choices.reply: He scores four goals the next match. Points at you after every one.

choices.label: 🩹 Help him tape them properly
choices.reply: They hold. Mostly.

beats.title: Failing English
beats.text: {nick} shows you his English test: 12%. "If I fail English for BECE, Papa go carry me back to the farm."

choices.label: 📚 Tutor him
choices.reply: Comprehension passages every night. He gets 58% in BECE English and runs a lap of honour.

choices.label: 🙈 "You go pass"
choices.reply: He scrapes through. Barely.

beats.title: The Scout
beats.text: A football academy scout watched {nick} at sports day. They're offering a place in Lagos — now, before WAEC. "What should I do?"

choices.label: ⚽ "Go. This is your dream."

fx.leave: left for a football academy in Lagos

choices.reply: He leaves on a Tuesday with one bag and your house colours tied round his wrist.

choices.label: 📚 "Finish school first"
choices.reply: He stays. He finishes. The dream waits — or doesn't.

beats.title: Night Vigil
beats.text: {nick} whispers in the dark: "We're holding a vigil in the bathroom. Midnight. Come and pray with us — revival must happen!"

choices.label: 🙏 Join them
choices.reply: The house master's torchlight catches all twelve of you mid-chorus. Worth it, says {nick}.

choices.label: 😴 "I go pray from my bed"
choices.reply: You hear singing at midnight. Then the house master. Then silence.

beats.title: {nick} and Halima
beats.text: {nick} and Halima are arguing about prayer times in the corridor. It's getting loud.

choices.label: 🤝 Bridge them — "Both of una dey pray for the same school"
choices.reply: They stare at you. Then at each other. By the end of term they're study partners.

choices.label: 🚶 Stay out of it
choices.reply: It blows over. Mostly.

beats.title: The Letter From Prison
beats.text: {nick} is crying behind the chapel, a letter crushed in her hand. "My brother. He's in prison. I've been praying so loud so nobody would hear how scared I am."

choices.label: 🫂 Sit with her
choices.reply: You don't need to say anything. Later she says you were the first person she told.

choices.label: 🙏 Pray with her
choices.reply: Quietly this time.

beats.title: The Love Letter
beats.text: Someone wrote {name} a love letter, full of terrible poetry, and signed it with YOUR name. Emeka is giggling behind his hand.

choices.label: 😤 Confront Emeka
choices.reply: "It was a joke!" {name} heard everything — and laughs.

choices.label: 😏 Play along
choices.reply: "Your poetry is… something," {name} says, smiling.

choices.label: 🫣 Tell {name} the truth
choices.reply: "I know. Emeka can't spell 'beautiful'."

beats.title: The Slam Book
beats.text: {name}'s slam book reaches you. Question 12: "Who is your crush?"

choices.label: ✍️ Write something honest (and PG)
choices.reply: You write "no comment 🙈". {name} reads it and doesn't stop smiling all day.

choices.label: 😂 Write something funny
choices.reply: "Mr. Bassey's cane." The whole class reads it.

beats.title: The Sketchbook
beats.text: {name} drops a sketchbook. It falls open: page after page of buildings — towers, a new hostel, a library with a glass roof.

choices.label: 🏛️ "These are amazing. You should be an architect."
choices.reply: Nobody has ever said that to {name}. They show you every new drawing for three years.

choices.label: 😂 "You dey draw house?"
choices.reply: {name} snatches it back and never mentions it again.

beats.title: The Send-forth Dance
beats.text: Send-forth night. The DJ plays the slow song. {name} looks across the hall at you.

choices.label: 💃🏾 Ask {name} to dance
choices.reply: One dance. Everybody whistles. You'll remember this one.

choices.label: 🙈 Dance with your squad instead
choices.reply: You dance with everybody. {name} dances near enough.

beats.title: Campaign Manager
beats.text: {nick} has posters already: "VOTE IFE — Discipline, Unity, Progress". "I need a campaign manager. You have people skills."

choices.label: 🤝 Run their campaign
choices.reply: They win by a landslide. "My first appointment: you, Assistant Class Captain."

choices.label: 🗳️ "I'm running against you"
choices.reply: "Then may the best leader win." They shake your hand, firmly.

beats.title: The Noisemakers' List
beats.text: {nick} hands the noisemakers' list to the teacher. Your best friend's name is on it — for laughing at a joke YOU told.

choices.label: ⚖️ Argue it fairly after class
choices.reply: {nick} listens, then crosses the name out. "You're right. Thank you for telling me straight."

choices.label: 📢 Turn the class against {nick}
choices.reply: The class boos {nick} for a week. You win this one.

beats.title: {nick} Collapses
beats.text: {nick} faints during morning assembly. Nurse Grace says: exhaustion. They've been sleeping three hours a night.

choices.label: 🫂 Take over some of their duties for a week
choices.reply: "Nobody has ever helped me carry anything," they say. They learn to delegate. Slowly.

choices.label: 📚 Bring them notes in sick bay

beats.title: The New Boy
beats.text: A tall, thin new boy stands at the front of class: "My name is Musa Abdullahi. I come from Sokoto." His English is slow. Somebody laughs. Then everybody laughs.

choices.label: 👋 Move your bag so he can sit beside you
choices.reply: "Na gode," he whispers. Thank you. He sits with you every day after.

choices.label: 😂 Laugh with the class
choices.reply: He looks at his desk for the rest of the period.

beats.title: The Pact
beats.text: {name}: "You help me with English. I help you with maths. Deal?"

choices.label: 🤝 Deal
choices.reply: By SS1 his English is better than half the class. Your maths is better than ever.

beats.title: The Solar Lamp
beats.text: {name}'s science-fair project: a solar lamp made from a broken radio, a pure-water sachet and a car battery. It works. "For my village."

choices.label: 💡 Help him present it
choices.reply: First prize. The commissioner shakes his hand.

beats.title: First Bucket Bath
beats.text: {nick} stares at a bucket of cold water and a cup. "…Where's the shower? Like, the actual shower?"

choices.label: 🪣 Show them the bucket technique
choices.reply: "This is mad." Ten minutes later: "Actually… that's kind of efficient."

choices.label: 😂 Film their face (mentally)
choices.reply: The whole hostel laughs. {nick} goes red.

beats.title: London Night
beats.text: {nick}: "Let me DJ Social Night. UK garage, grime, Afroswing. Trust me."

choices.label: 🎧 Back them
choices.reply: First 10 minutes: confused silence. Then the juniors go crazy. Legendary.

beats.title: Staying?
beats.text: {nick}'s parents say they can go back to London for university. "I don't know anymore. This place is… home now? Is that mad?"

choices.label: 🏠 "Stay. Lagos needs your music."
choices.reply: They stay. Their first song samples the rising bell.

choices.label: ✈️ "Go — but don't forget us"
choices.reply: They promise. They mostly keep it.

beats.title: Your School Parent
beats.text: {full} finds you after the provision inspection: "From today, you are under me. Anybody touch you, mention my name. And BATHE — I'll check."

choices.label: 🙇 "Thank you, Senior!"
choices.reply: They pat your head. You feel ten feet tall.

choices.label: 😅 "Senior, I dey bathe na!"
choices.reply: "We shall see," they say, sniffing theatrically.

beats.title: WAEC Errands
beats.text: {full} is drowning in WAEC revision: "Junior, I need water, garri, and somebody to quiz me on Biology."

choices.label: 🧺 Run their errands and quiz them
choices.reply: They pass every paper. They say it was the garri.

beats.title: Senior {name} Graduates
beats.text: Sign-out day for the SS3s. {full} gives you their old mattress, a bucket and a folded note: "Be a better senior than the ones who were wicked to you."

choices.label: 🎓 Sign their shirt
choices.reply: You write "Thank you" in letters so big they cover the whole back.

beats.title: "Frog Jump. NOW."
beats.text: {nick} catches you walking past the SS2 corridor: "Junior! You no greet? Frog jump to the tap and back. NOW."

choices.label: 🐸 Do it without complaining
choices.reply: Your thighs are on fire. {nick} watches, almost impressed you didn't cry.

choices.label: 📣 Report to the house master
choices.reply: {nick} is warned. The SS2s now call you "Snitch" whenever you pass.

choices.label: ✊ "Senior, I greeted you. I won't frog jump."
choices.reply: Gasps. You're punished — but word spreads: this junior has liver.

beats.title: The Stairs
beats.text: {nick} pushed a JSS1 boy down the hostel stairs for "sleeping in". The boy is in sick bay with a broken arm. Everybody saw. Nobody is saying anything.

choices.label: 📣 Tell the house master what you saw
choices.reply: Commander is suspended. Some seniors hate you. The JSS1s look at you like a hero.

choices.label: 🤐 Stay silent
choices.reply: The boy says he "fell". You know he didn't.

beats.title: An Unexpected Apology
beats.text: On their last day, {nick} finds you by the gate. They don't look at you. "Junior. That thing I did to you people… my father did it to me. E no make am right. Sorry."

choices.label: 🤝 Accept it
choices.reply: They nod once and walk to the car. You'll think about this when you're SS2.

choices.label: 🚶 Walk away
choices.reply: Some sorries come too late.

beats.title: The Assembly Speech
beats.text: {full} gives the assembly speech: "This school is not these buildings. It's how we treat the smallest person in it." The whole ground is silent.

choices.label: 👏 Clap loudest
choices.reply: {full} catches your eye and nods.

choices.label: ✍️ Write it down
choices.reply: You keep it in your notebook for six years.

beats.title: A Note for the Future
beats.text: {full} graduates. On the prefects' noticeboard: a sealed envelope — "For whoever becomes Head Prefect one day. Don't open until then."

choices.label: 📜 Remember it
choices.reply: Somebody in this school will open it in five years.

beats.title: Your School Child
beats.text: A small JSS1 student is crying at the hostel door, holding a bucket with both hands. The house master: "This is {full}. Your school child. Take care of them."

choices.label: 🤝 "Nobody touches you while I'm here"
choices.reply: {name} stops crying. You see yourself, five years ago.

choices.label: 😤 "Carry my bucket first"
choices.reply: {name} carries it, shaking. Hmm. Is this who you became?

beats.title: Somebody Is Bullying {name}
beats.text: {name} has a bruise and won't say where it came from. Then you hear: a boy in YOUR set has been "collecting" {name}'s provisions.

choices.label: 🛡️ Confront your coursemate
choices.reply: "Touch my school child again and see." It stops that day.

choices.label: 🤷 "Na so school be"
choices.reply: {name} stops coming to you for anything. Later you hear them say: "Senior, why are you like Commander?"

beats.title: "Small" Ali
beats.text: A tiny JSS1 boy, {name}, mimics YOUR walk in front of the whole corridor. Perfectly. The juniors are dying of laughter.

choices.label: 😂 Laugh — it was good
choices.reply: "Senior, you get sense!" He becomes your unofficial court jester.

choices.label: 🐸 Punish him
choices.reply: Ten frog jumps. He grins through every one.

choices.label: 🎭 "Do the house master next"
choices.reply: He does. It's even better.

beats.title: Different Classes
beats.text: SS1. Departments split the set. {name} is in a different class now. On the first night they lean over the bunk: "Promise we no go scatter because of class."

choices.label: 🤞🏾 "Never. Same table every lunch."
choices.reply: Every lunch for three years. Even when it rains.

choices.label: 😅 "We go see"
choices.reply: {name} laughs a little too quickly. By SS2 you're waving across the dining hall instead of sitting together.

beats.title: Different Classes
beats.text: SS1. {name} is in another department. They find you on the first evening: "You were there when my parents… I won't forget. Promise we stay close?"

choices.label: 🤞🏾 "Always."
choices.reply: They hug you so hard your bucket falls.

choices.label: 😅 "We go try"
choices.reply: "Try" turns into "sometimes".

beats.title: {name} Is Running Too
beats.text: The prefect list is being decided. {name} — who hasn't spoken to you properly since SS2 — is campaigning for the same post as you. Their posters say "Choose someone who stays loyal." Everyone knows who that's about.

choices.label: 🤝 Go to them before it gets ugly
choices.reply: Behind the hostel you both talk for the first time in a year. You end up campaigning for each other. The teachers are very confused.

choices.label: 🧼 Campaign clean
choices.reply: You never mention them. Your speech is about the juniors. Win or lose, people notice.

choices.label: 🗞️ Spread their secret
choices.reply: Their parents' divorce is the school's gist by Friday. You win the votes. You lose something else.

beats.title: Across the Hall
beats.text: Send-forth. {name} is dancing with their new friends across the hall. They catch your eye for a second, then look away.

choices.label: 🚶🏾 Walk over anyway
choices.reply: "…Hi." "Hi." It's not fixed. But it's not nothing.

choices.label: 🍗 Stay with your plate
choices.reply: Six years, two bunks, one last look.

beats.title: {nick}'s Crew
beats.text: {nick} has a crew now — four boys who think the snitch from JSS1 needs "correction". Every morning this week your bucket has been hidden, your slippers thrown on the roof.

choices.label: 🙏 Offer peace — and your Strongman tin
choices.reply: {nick} turns the tin in his hands. "…You get liver to come here alone." The crew leaves you alone from that day.

choices.label: 🏴 Bring your own squad
choices.reply: It ends in a pillow-and-slippers battle the whole hostel talks about. Nobody wins. The war continues.

choices.label: 📣 Report them all
choices.reply: The house master punishes all four. They will never forget. Neither will {nick}.

beats.title: The Last Battle
beats.text: SS2. You and {nick} are both seniors now, and your feud has split the set in two. The juniors are taking sides.

choices.label: 🤝 End it — publicly
choices.reply: In front of everyone at dinner, you offer your hand. A long pause. He takes it. The juniors clap like it's a final.

choices.label: 😤 Keep fighting
choices.reply: It lasts until graduation. Your juniors learn exactly the wrong lesson.

beats.title: {nick} Has Your Back
beats.text: An SS2 senior tries to collect your provisions. Before you can answer, {nick} is standing between you: "Senior. This one na my person. Find another person."

choices.label: 😮 Thank him later
choices.reply: "You taught me to read," he shrugs. "Na small thing."

choices.label: 🤜🏾 Stand beside him
choices.reply: Two of you. The senior decides your provisions aren't worth it.

beats.title: Planted
beats.text: The house master searches every locker after a theft. In YOURS: three tins of somebody else's Strongman. Across the room, {nick} won't look at you.

choices.label: 🗣️ Confront {nick} in front of everyone
choices.reply: "Prove am," he says. You can't. You're punished — but now everyone is watching him too.

choices.label: 🧠 Prove it quietly
choices.reply: The tins have {nick}'s handwriting on the price tag — from his business. The house master gives him your punishment. He looks at you differently after that: respect, and fear.

choices.label: 🙏 Settle it — "We dey even now?"
choices.reply: He blinks. "…Okay. We dey even." You take the punishment. He owes you, and you both know it.

beats.title: The Hostel Store
beats.text: SS1. {nick} has a plan: a proper store in the corner of the hostel — biscuits, sachet water, Kwik Noodles, all cheaper than Mama Tuck-shop. "Fifty-fifty. Put ₦1,000."

choices.label: 📝 Do it — but ask the house master first
choices.reply: The house master is so surprised to be asked that he says yes. By SS2 the store pays for both of your provisions.

choices.label: 🤫 Do it underground
choices.reply: Business booms… and the habit of hiding things grows.

choices.label: 🙅 "I dey for my books"
choices.reply: He runs it alone. It does fine.

beats.title: A Letter From Lagos
beats.text: A letter on fancy paper: "My mum says you MUST come for the long holiday. We have a pool. Bring nothing — I'll lend you everything. — Z"

choices.label: 🏝️ Go
choices.reply: Two weeks of air conditioning and jollof that isn't from a cooler. Her mother calls you "the one who came".

choices.label: 🏠 "My parents won't allow"
choices.reply: She sends photos of the pool every week. You pretend not to care.

beats.title: Queen Zara
beats.text: SS1. Zara runs the class now — the clothes, the parties, who's in and who's out. And this week, you are very much out. Her girls laugh when you pass.

choices.label: 🫂 Talk to her alone
choices.reply: "You left me in that toilet on Visiting Day," she says quietly. "Everyone always leaves." You stay this time.

choices.label: 😎 Build your own crowd
choices.reply: Two tables, two queens. The juniors pick sides.

choices.label: 🤷 Ignore it
choices.reply: It's a long term.

beats.title: Every Little Thing
beats.text: Since you read her notebook to the class in JSS2, {nick} has reported you for everything: talking in prep, an untucked shirt, a late bucket. Today it's the third time this week.

choices.label: 🙏 Apologise for JSS2 — properly
choices.reply: She stares for a long time. "Do you know how long I waited for that?" She tears the page with your name on it.

choices.label: 🪤 Set her up
choices.reply: It works for a day. Then it doesn't. The VP is not amused.

choices.label: 🧊 Give her nothing to write
choices.reply: A spotless term. It's exhausting. She looks almost disappointed.

beats.title: The Study Group
beats.text: SS1. {name} has started a study group in the library: six people, three colours of highlighter, zero jokes. "You're the deputy. Don't argue."

choices.label: 📚 Run it with them
choices.reply: By SS2 the study group has a waiting list. The teachers come to see what's going on.

choices.label: 😴 Show up sometimes
choices.reply: "Sometimes" is not a word {name} respects.

beats.title: The Last Race
beats.text: WAEC is weeks away. {name} slides a paper across the library table: "Six years. Final score. Whoever gets more A1s chooses where the other one sits at the send-forth."

choices.label: ✍️ "Deal."
choices.reply: The most intense six weeks of your life. Whoever wins, you both come out better.

choices.label: 🤝 "Let's study together instead"
choices.reply: {name} hesitates — then laughs for the first time in years. "Fine. But I'm still beating you."

beats.title: {name} Remembers
beats.text: SS1. {name}'s English is perfect now. When you ask him to help you with physics, he says, very politely: "You laughed when I couldn't speak. Ask somebody else."

choices.label: 🙏 "I was wrong. I'm sorry."
choices.reply: He looks at you for a long moment. "…Sit. Physics first. Then you buy me suya."

choices.label: 😤 "Na three years ago!"
choices.reply: "Exactly. Three years, and you never said sorry."
